_comment: Hand-maintained (not generated). Per print: where the reader gets page images. kind 'local' = AVIF derivatives written by src/make_image_derivatives.py (path_template, {print} and {stem} are substituted); kind 'iiif' prints stay in iiif_manifests.json. hathitrust.seq_offset: HathiTrust seq = local page number + seq_offset; null = not yet confirmed, in which case the reader shows no HathiTrust link (never a guessed one). kind 'iiif': pages come from the manifest in iiif_manifests.json. A path_template may be an absolute URL (external image host).
